programs.name: suinvvxzco
programs.purpose: Invert common-offset seismic traces using a two-dimensional velocity model and an optional slowness perturbation.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUINVXZCO - Seismic INVersion of Common Offset data for a smooth

params.name: nx
params.description: Number of velocity samples in x.

params.name: nz
params.description: Number of velocity samples in depth.

params.name: vfile
params.description: Binary float velocity model, with depth fastest.

params.name: dt
params.description: Input sample interval; must be positive.

params.name: nxd
params.description: Midpoint interval between calculated traveltime tables.

params.name: nxb
params.description: Half-width of the velocity band in samples.

params.name: nxc
params.description: Horizontal velocity modification range; clamped to nxb.

params.name: nzc
params.description: Vertical velocity modification range; clamped to nz.

params.name: vpfile
params.description: Binary perturbation model; required when pert is nonzero.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Finite-difference eikonal solving, tridiagonal solving, polar interpolation, amplitude and trace accumulation, and transcendental math are sensitive to precision and operation order.
programs.difficulty_reason: The inversion combines eikonal solving, ray amplitudes, interpolation, and multi-trace accumulation.

programs.name: suinvzco3d
programs.purpose: Invert three-dimensional common-offset traces using a velocity function of depth.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUINVZCO3D - Seismic INVersion of Common Offset data with V(Z) velocity

params.name: nxm
params.description: Number of input midpoints per line.

params.name: dxm
params.description: Midpoint spacing; also read a second time into the internal velocity x spacing, which defaults to 50 when dxm is absent.

params.name: dx
params.description: Listed in selfdoc, but never parsed: internal dx is read from dxm or defaults to 50.

params.name: fx
params.description: Listed in selfdoc but never parsed or used.

params.name: nxd
params.description: Listed in selfdoc but never parsed or used.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Ray integration, determinants, interpolation, amplitude accumulation and transcendental operations are sensitive to evaluation order. Velocity interpolation can access v[nsamp+1] beyond the allocated array at the model's last sample.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program performs three-dimensional inversion using ray tracing and interpolated amplitude tables.

programs.name: sukdmig2d
programs.purpose: Perform two-dimensional Kirchhoff depth migration using supplied traveltime tables.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUKDMIG2D - Kirchhoff Depth Migration of 2D poststack/prestack data

params.name: offmax
params.description: Maximum absolute offset; selfdoc instead says 99999.

params.name: limoff
params.description: Restrict traces to output offset range.

params.name: tvfile
params.description: Traveltime variation tables; required when npv is nonzero.

params.name: csfile
params.description: Cosine tables; required when npv is nonzero.

params.name: outfile1
params.description: Additional output when npv is nonzero.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT filtering, traveltime interpolation, reference-ray calculations and migration sums depend on floating-point order and math-library results.
programs.difficulty_reason: Kirchhoff migration combines FFT filtering, table interpolation, offset binning and optional velocity-analysis outputs.

programs.name: sukdmig3d
programs.purpose: Perform three-dimensional Kirchhoff depth migration using trace-formatted traveltime tables.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUKDMIG3D - Kirchhoff Depth Migration of 3D poststack/prestack data

params.name: fxgd
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header f1

params.name: dxgd
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header d1

params.name: nxt
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header ns
params.description: Table x samples; subsequently divided by multit.

params.name: multit
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header scalel; zero becomes 1

params.name: fygd
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header f2

params.name: dygd
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header d2

params.name: nyt
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header ntr

params.name: nxgd
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header selev
params.description: Documented as a parameter, but read only from the table header.

params.name: nygd
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header gelev
params.description: Documented as a parameter, but read only from the table header.

params.name: nxs
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header nhs

params.name: nys
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header nvs

params.name: nzs
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header duse

params.name: ixsf
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header sdel

params.name: iysf
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header gdel

params.name: fzs
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header sdepth / 1000

params.name: ixsr
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header swdep
params.description: Source x spacing in grid samples.

params.name: iysr
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header gwdep
params.description: Source y spacing in grid samples.

params.name: dzs
params.default: computed: first traveltime trace header ep / 1000

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: first data trace header dt / 1000

params.name: ft
params.default: computed: first data trace header delrt / 1000

params.name: dxm
params.default: computed: first data trace header d2

params.name: angmax
params.description: Used directly as radians, including when supplied.

params.name: fmax
params.description: Maximum frequency in the program's time units.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT filtering, quantized traveltime and ray-path tables, multidimensional interpolation, migration accumulation, and float/double math affect reproducibility.
programs.difficulty_reason: The research migration code manages multidimensional tables, multiple arrivals, filtering and three-dimensional image accumulation.

programs.name: suktmig2d
programs.purpose: Perform two-dimensional prestack time migration of a common-offset section using RMS velocities.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUKTMIG2D - prestack time migration of a common-offset

params.name: vfile
params.description: Binary float RMS velocity array, time fastest.

params.name: firstcdp
params.default: computed: first input trace header cdp

params.name: fcdpdata
params.default: computed: first input trace header cdp

params.name: hoffset
params.default: computed: 0.5 * first input trace header offset

params.name: nfc
params.description: Number of Fourier coefficients for low-pass filters.

params.name: lastcdp
params.default: computed: last input trace header cdp

params.name: dcdp
params.default: computed: last observed input CDP increment minus 1
params.description: CDP increment; the code subtracts one from the observed increment.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT low-pass filtering, sinc interpolation, DSR travel times and migration sums depend on floating-point ordering and transcendental implementations.
programs.difficulty_reason: The prestack migration performs FFT antialias filtering, interpolated imaging and multi-trace accumulation.

programs.name: sumigfd
programs.purpose: Perform finite-difference depth migration of zero-offset seismic traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUMIGFD - 45-90 degree Finite difference depth migration for

params.name: vfile
params.description: Binary float velocity array with x fastest.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: first trace header dt / 1000000, or 0.004 if header dt is zero

params.name: dx
params.default: computed: first trace header d2, or 1.0 if header d2 is zero

params.name: dip
params.description: Maximum dip angle; supported values are listed in the selfdoc.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable, or empty string
params.description: Temporary file directory; empty selects tmpfile().

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Complex FFTs, phase shifts and repeated complex tridiagonal solves depend on floating-point order and transcendental implementations; the code mixes double and float values.
programs.difficulty_reason: Depth continuation combines FFTs and repeated complex finite-difference solves.
